messages: I got an email saying my password had been changed, but I didn’t make that change. Now I can’t sign in.
There’s a login from a city I’ve never been to, and I was home at the time. Can you help me secure my profile?
I’m seeing purchases in my history that aren’t mine. I changed my password, but I’m still worried.
